title: head_to_head double-counts fixtures duplicated across source CSVs
evidence: src/brazilian_soccer_mcp/core.clj:170 filters (:matches (data)) directly and never calls dedupe-matches, unlike find-matches (core.clj:151). Flamengo-Palmeiras 2019 appears twice in each of Brasileirao_Matches.csv, novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (both map to :competition "brasileirao") and BR-Football-Dataset.csv, so a two-team H2H sums each fixture 2-3x. The H2H test (test/.../core_test.clj:17-24) only uses a 2-match in-memory fixture, so the dup path is never exercised.
suggestion: Pipe games through dedupe-matches (as find-matches does) before reducing, or build head-to-head on top of find-matches.

title: factual_accuracy=0.0 for standings is a checker false-negative, not a code defect
evidence: _factual.json raw output shows 2019 Serie A correct: flamengo 28W-6D-4L 90pts position 1 played 38, and BOTH 'atletico pr' (pos 5) and 'atletico mg' (pos 13) present = 20 clubs. The 'row figures' display in the note is a flattened/garbled vector; the checker's '19 of 20 (1 Atletico row)' collapsed the two distinct Atletico clubs. Test standings-use-a-single-canonical-season (core_test.clj:31-36) asserts exactly 20 teams and Flamengo 38/28/6/4/90 on REAL data and passes (test_coverage=1.0).
suggestion: No code change needed; standings (core.clj:212-230) computes a correct, deduplicated table by restricting to :source "brasileirao". The factual checker needs to handle multi-word club keys and un-flatten the standings vector.

title: Low idiomatic score (0.3)
